text: A modern Class A office building in the heart of the Mokotów business district. The seven-storey building offers a wide range of amenities and services. Its efficiency and energy savings are confirmed by a BREEAM certificate at the “Very Good” level. Konstruktorska Business Center has 4 separate entrances and two internal recreational courtyards, offers 1,050 parking spaces in the underground garage, as well as facilities for cyclists.
